title: Blank Slate (Script-Driven Example)
description: An original example of the script-as-product pattern, modeled on Auto-Cards. The opening is a single word and there are no hand-built story cards, because the value lives entirely in an installed script (e.g. Auto-Cards or Inner Self) that generates cards and tracks state during play. The scenario is just a launch pad. NOTE: the script itself is NOT bundled here — install it by cloning its canonical repo (see scripting.md), never by recreating it.
